title: 第7章 你指点我第8章 惊退妖王
slug: 杂役都是仙帝你管这叫没落宗门
lines: “林峰主，可是让我这把老骨头一阵好等啊！”来人见到林玄后，冷哼一声，言语中的不满，任谁都听得出来。
林玄干笑两声：“让荃长老久等了。”
这位女长老，林玄认识，来自三十六峰中的第十峰，清微峰。
这清微峰上下，以女性弟子居多，男性弟子虽有，但很少。
清微峰，也是三十六峰中，盛产美女的地方，在宗内极其受欢迎，峰主清微仙子，一位新晋不久的王境强者，更是有着青阳剑宗第一美人之称。
其爱慕者遍布整个青阳剑宗，其中不乏一些峰主。
而值得一提的是，清微峰和星陨峰一样，都是站在圣女李扶风这边的。
清微峰之所以没有跟随大部队前往焚天秘境，便是因为李扶风的吩咐。
焚天秘境，位于映月山脉最中心，去往的途中极为凶险，特别是在进入映月山脉内部后，哪怕是王境都有着陨落的风险。
星陨峰，只有林玄这么一个“劫境七重”，去往焚天秘境可谓是危险重重。
知晓这一点的李扶风，便安排清微峰主留了下来，让其和星陨峰一同前往。
这才有了这位荃长老在星陨峰等候多时一事。
虽然以如今自己的实力，在前往焚天秘境途中并不需要他人保驾护航，但李扶风，的确是有心了。
“既然林峰主出关了，我便回去跟峰主复命了，还请林峰主准备一番，明日便出发。”
荃长老脸色冷厉，通知一声后，便离开了星陨峰。
林玄这边，在荃长老离开后，便传讯给自己的三位弟子，让他们也准备一下。
只是……
当林玄神识扫过星陨峰，却是不见曲幽梦的身影。
而后林玄才从苏怜心那里得知，曲幽梦在宗门大比奖励公布后，便离开了宗门，只留给了她一封信，让她告知林玄一声。
这也在林玄意料之中，本来他也没真把对方当成自己的弟子，收她只不过是为了看上了她可以给自己大幅增加修炼速度罢了。
翌日。
一大早清微峰的飞舟便是停靠在了星陨峰广场之上。
庞然大物般的飞舟，如同一座空中阁楼，足以容纳近千人。而这样一艘飞舟在青阳剑宗，也不是任意一峰就能拥有的，唯有拥有王境强者的前十峰才有。
不仅是因为飞舟本身造价极高，且养护成本极高，每一次驱动都要消耗大量灵石。
望着眼前这艘庞然大物，王焱和苏怜心眼中都显露出震撼。
他们是第一次见到宗门飞舟，以往只是听说过。
而位于飞舟之上的清微峰弟子，看着王焱和苏怜心这副没见过世面的模样，神色间隐约浮现几缕得意之色。
带着弟子二人上了飞舟，林玄率先看到位于甲板上的那位清冷女子。
美目澈似秋水，面容细腻如白玉，倾城绝世，仿佛画中走出的仙子一般，青阳剑宗第一美人之称，当之无愧。
她，正是第十峰清微峰峰主，清微仙子。
同时也是青阳剑宗最年轻的王境。
“前几日正逢悟道关键时刻，耽搁了些许，让诸位久等了。”林玄朝清微峰主等人拱了拱手，解释了一句，可他不解释还好，一解释，清微仙子秀眉轻轻一皱。
还没等她开口，位于她身旁的几位清微峰长老，便已经是笑出了声。
悟道？你个劫境七重悟什么道？编也不会编个好点的理由。
其中一位中年长老，更是有些阴阳怪气的道：“哦？悟道？，敢问林峰主是在悟何大道？不如说出来，你我二人论上一论？”
言语中的讥讽之意，任谁都能听得出来。
林玄瞥

content_en:
"Master Lin, please let me, this old man, wait for a while!" After seeing Lin Xuan, the visitor snorted coldly, and anyone could hear the dissatisfaction in his words.
Lin Xuan laughed twice: "I've kept Elder Quan waiting for a long time."
This female elder, whom Lin Xuan knew, came from the tenth peak among the thirty-six peaks, Qingwei Peak.
Up and down Qingwei Peak, there are mostly female disciples. Although there are male disciples, they are very few.
Qingwei Peak is also a place rich in beauties among the thirty-six peaks. It is extremely popular in the sect. The leader of the peak, Fairy Qingwei, is a newly promoted King Realm expert and is known as the most beautiful woman in Qingyang Sword Sect.
His admirers are all over the Qingyang Sword Sect, including some peak masters.
It is worth mentioning that Qingwei Peak and Xingyun Peak are both on the side of Saint Li Fufeng.
The reason why Qingweifeng did not follow the large army to the Burning Heaven Secret Realm was because of Li Fufeng's orders.
The Fentian Secret Realm is located in the center of the Yingyue Mountains. The journey there is extremely dangerous, especially after entering the Yingyue Mountains. Even those in the King realm are at risk of falling.
In Xingyun Peak, there was only Lin Xuan who was at the seventh level of the Tribulation Realm. Going to the Burning Sky Secret Realm was extremely dangerous.
Knowing this, Li Fufeng arranged for the master of Qingwei Peak to stay and let him go to Xingyun Peak together.
This led to the fact that Elder Quan had been waiting at Starfall Peak for a long time.
Although with his current strength, he does not need others to escort him on his way to the Burning Heaven Secret Realm, Li Fufeng does have a good intention.
"Now that Master Lin is out of seclusion, I will go back and resume my duties with Master Lin. I also asked Master Lin to make some preparations and set off tomorrow."
Elder Quan's face was cold and stern, and after giving the notice, he left Starfall Peak.
On Lin Xuan's side, after Elder Quan left, he summoned his three disciples and asked them to prepare as well.
Just...
When Lin Xuan's spiritual consciousness swept across the Starfall Peak, Qu Youmeng was nowhere to be seen.
Later, Lin Xuan learned from Su Lianxin that Qu Youmeng left the sect after the rewards of the sect competition were announced, leaving her only a letter asking her to inform Lin Xuan.
This was also expected by Lin Xuan. He didn't really regard her as his disciple. He only accepted her because she could greatly increase his cultivation speed.
The next day.
Early in the morning, Qingweifeng's flying boat docked at the Starfall Peak Square.
The huge flying boat is like a sky attic, able to accommodate nearly a thousand people. And such a flying boat cannot be owned by any peak in the Qingyang Sword Sect. It can only be owned by the top ten peaks with king-level experts.
Not only is the flying boat itself extremely expensive to build, but also the maintenance cost is extremely high. Each time it is driven, a large amount of spiritual stones are consumed.
Looking at the huge ship in front of them, Wang Yan and Su Lianxin's eyes were filled with shock.
This was their first time seeing the sect flying boat, and they had only heard of it in the past.
The disciples of Qingwei Peak who were sitting on the flying boat looked at Wang Yan and Su Lianxin who had never seen the world before, and there was a hint of pride in their expressions.
After taking the two disciples onto the flying boat, Lin Xuan was the first to see the cold woman on the deck.
Her beautiful eyes are as clear as autumn water, and her face is as delicate as white jade. She is as alluring as a fairy walking out of a painting. She is well-deserved to be called the most beautiful woman in the Qingyang Sword Sect.
She is the leader of Qingwei Peak, the tenth peak, Fairy Qingwei.
At the same time, he is also the youngest king in the Qingyang Sword Sect.
"The past few days were at the critical moment of enlightenment, so I was delayed a little and kept you all waiting for a long time." Lin Xuan bowed his hands to Master Qingwei Peak and others, and explained, but it was better that he didn't explain. Once he explained, Fairy Qingwei frowned slightly.
Before she could speak, several Qingweifeng elders beside her were already laughing.
Enlightenment? What path have you realized at the seventh level of the Tribulation Realm? The editor can't even make up a better reason.
One of the middle-aged elders said in a rather strange tone: "Oh? Enlightenment? May I ask what kind of path Master Lin is enlightening? Why don't you tell me, and you and I can discuss it?"
Anyone can hear the sarcasm in his words.
Lin Xuanzhu
